title: rera_project_rows.jsonl — RERA project listing row
description: One project from a state RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Authority) portal's project listing. The shared core is thin on purpose: every column the portal publishes is kept verbatim in `fields`, keyed by the portal's own header string, so nothing is lost and no state's columns are normalized into another's. The typed date properties carry only dates that a live capture confirmed (Karnataka, November 2026); `additionalProperties` stays true so later states can add their own. The probe records the dates the portal publishes and never computes delay: the gap between the original and the current proposed completion date is interpretation, and belongs downstream. An extension cell is a RANGE (`dd-mm-yyyy - dd-mm-yyyy`, a start and a new end date), so each extension has a `_start` and an `_end`. Karnataka lists 47 Bengaluru Urban COVID-19 extensions with a start and no end, so `_end` is null while `_start` is set. `registration_no` is null for a project that has an acknowledgement number but was never registered. The `key` therefore uses the identifier the portal assigns first (Karnataka's acknowledgement number), so it stays the same when a registration number is later issued.
